semantic.justification: Direct TypeScript port of the pinned md4c 0.5.3 UTF-8 block, mark-resolution and callback pipeline. Preserves source byte offsets, callback chunk boundaries and attributes, source flag defaults, reference budgets, container state and callback abort codes. All 813 complete callback streams match compiled unmodified md_parse, including 733 bundled CommonMark/extension cases. Native allocation failures, C pointer ABI and unused/uninitialized fields are not emulated. Writer callback integration remains pending; these dependency fixtures do not establish complete Writer import parity. B8TCAE adds14 minimized public UTF8 input/flag cases to the existing native-edge callback corpus: unclosed/escaped link destinations and labels, terminal angle prefixes, table delimiter/header boundaries, collapsed spaces, unmatched strikethrough/math delimiters and terminal WWW slashes. All complete initialized callback streams are regenerated by the unchanged pinned md4c0.5.3 source after exact archive/member verification. Existing full callback and block-consumer suites replay the same cases. Diagnostic selection only read per-call Istanbul deltas; temporary diagnostics were removed and no source state, coverage counter, exclusion or threshold was changed. Current6 suites1848 tests pass; exact-map before/after comparison closes11 statements and19 branch arms. Remaining full100 coverage and ABI/resource-failure claims are not certified. B8TCAE-M06 uses the standing human authorization for proven unreachable coverage branches: the original collector always appends a resolved ch127 sentinel, n_marks never decreases after collection, and entity analysis dispatches only ampersand marks. Thus the next-mark bounds guard cannot return for actual parser-owned marks. The guard remains; only one zero-hit return and its alternative are annotated, with an explicit no-op else retaining the normal source-map alternative. Exact token/remapped-counter comparison preserves all other statements, alternatives and10 functions. All8 MD4C suites pass; strict owner coverage is145 statements,90 alternatives,10 functions and139 lines at100%. This is an ordinary sentinel precondition, not a suspected upstream defect or a promise for fabricated private contexts.
